title: A Slack message reaches the Lead and its answer posts back in the thread
description: Against a stand-in Slack Socket Mode server on 127.0.0.1: `mainworks lead slack connect` stores the piped app and bot tokens with mode 0600 and prints nothing; a message in the bound channel from the owner becomes a Lead message with the Slack display name as its source, the loop's real cycle wakes the Lead with it once, and the Lead's `lead reply` posts back in that Slack thread. A person not allowed is ignored with one line, and a reserved decision goes to Needs you with buttons only the owner may answer.
